ranking.note: Only active opportunities are ranked; fewer than ten is valid. Score is not win probability. Correlation penalty is separate from raw score.

fx_ranking.ranking_type: FX research shortlist; not an entry signal

coverage.fundamental_scope: BIS policy-rate carry and 90-day change proxy only

limitations: The fundamental component is only a BIS policy-rate carry and 90-day change proxy; inflation, growth, labor and market-consensus surprises are not integrated.
The connected free calendar covers US high-impact releases only; the other seven currency legs remain unverified.
Expert claims are unverified and count only when at least two independent specialist publishers provide named authors.
A Yahoo Finance indicative quote is not an executable broker price; spread, commission, slippage and venue liquidity remain separate gates.
The score is a relative research ranking, not a win probability or investment recommendation.

economic_calendar.attribution: Release dates and figures: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Bureau of Economic Analysis, Census Bureau, Federal Reserve Board, FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis) and U.S. Treasury. This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
economic_calendar.data_note: High-impact US releases only. It is not a global FX calendar; the other seven currencies require separate validated providers.

USD.series_title: Central bank policy rates - United States - Daily - End of period
USD.compilation: From 19 Dec 1985 onwards: mid-point of the Federal Reserve target rate; from 1 Jul 1954 to 18 Dec 1985: US Fed Funds effective rate.

EUR.series_title: Central bank policy rates - Euro area - Daily - End of period
EUR.compilation: From 18 Sep 2024 onwards: official central bank steering rate is the deposit facility rate, fixed rate; from 15 Oct 2008 to 17 Sep 2024: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate; from 28 Jun 2000 to 14 Oct 2008: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, minimum bid rate; from 5 Jan 1999 to 27 Jun 2000: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate.

GBP.series_title: Central bank policy rates - United Kingdom - Daily - End of period
GBP.compilation: From 3 Aug 2006 onwards: official bank rate; from 6 May 1997 to 2 Aug 2006: repo rate; from 20 Aug 1981 to 5 May 1997: minimum Bank of England Band 1 dealing rate; from 16 Oct 1972 to 19 Aug 1981: minimum lending rate; from 1 Jan 1946 to 15 Oct 1972: bank rate.

JPY.series_title: Central bank policy rates - Japan - Daily - End of period
JPY.compilation: From 24 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.25 percent; From 17 Jun 2026 to 23 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.00 percent; From 22 Dec 2025 to 16 Jun 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.75 percent; From 27 Jan 2025 to 21 Dec 2025: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.50 percent; From 1 Aug 2024 to 26 Jan 2025: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.25% ; From 21 Mar 2024 to 31 July: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1 %; from 21 Sep 2016 to 20 Mar 2024: the BOJ set the guideline for market operations which specifies a short-term policy interest rate at minus 0.1% and a target level of 10-year JGB yields at around 0%. Short-term policy interest rate; from 4 Apr 2013 to 20 Sep 2016: no policy rate; from 5 Oct 2010 to 3 Apr 2013: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1%; from 19 Dec 2008 to 4 Oct 2010: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0. %; from 31 Oct 2008 to 18 Dec 2008: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.3%; before 30 Oct 2008, refer to https://data.bis.org/topics/CBPOL

CHF.series_title: Central bank policy rates - Switzerland - Daily - End of period
CHF.compilation: From 13 June 2019 onwards SNB Policy rate; From 1 Jan 2000 to 12 June 2019 mid-point of the SNB target range; from 1 Jan 1946 to 31 Dec 1999: discount rate.

CAD.series_title: Central bank policy rates - Canada - Daily - End of period
CAD.compilation: From 1 Jun 1994 onwards: Central Bank target, overnight rate; from 27 Jul 1960 to 31 May 1994: official bank rate.

AUD.series_title: Central bank policy rates - Australia - Daily - End of period
AUD.compilation: From 2 Aug 1990 onwards: cash rate target; from 23 Jan 1990 to 1 Aug 1990: middle of the cash rate target range; from 7 Apr 1976 to 22 Jan 1990: interbank overnight cash rate.

NZD.series_title: Central bank policy rates - New Zealand - Daily - End of period
NZD.compilation: From 17 Mar 1999 onwards: Official market intervention representative rate, official cash rate; from Jan 1985 to 16 Mar 1999: overnight cash rate.

policy_rates.methodology_note: Policy-rate carry and 90-day policy-rate change are macro proxies, not a complete fundamental forecast. Country-area policy instruments and publication timing can differ.
